translations.web: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
translations.bsb: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
translations.kjv: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
